claims: Bianca Belair announced her pregnancy at WrestleMania 42 on Saturday, April 18, 2026.
Bianca Belair revealed a baby bump to the crowd alongside her husband Montez Ford.
Montez Ford is a fellow WWE wrestler.
Bianca Belair made the announcement upon returning.
Bianca Belair confirmed she would not be competing.
WrestleMania 42 was at Allegiant Stadium in Las Vegas.
Bianca Belair is taking time away from in-ring competition to prepare for the birth of her first child with Montez Ford.
